_notes: Hand-authored crafting material catalog, same exception-to-procedural-generation pattern as data/items/bags.json. Real WoW Classic material names/tiers/profession assignments (sourced from live game data), scaled from Classic's 1-300 profession skill / mob-level gates down to this project's 1-60 player level cap at roughly a 1:5 ratio - e.g. Mithril Ore (Classic: skill 175, mob level ~40-50) becomes required_level 35 here, keeping its relative position in the progression rather than its literal Classic number. Professions themselves (recipes, skill-up mechanics, gathering nodes/skinning integration) are NOT built yet - this is materials data only, ready for that system to consume. See _profession_notes below for how each profession's materials interrelate (e.g. Blacksmithing consumes Mining's bars, Enchanting consumes Tailoring's cloth-disenchant byproducts). EXPANSION HEADROOM: entries with "backup": true (44 of the 131 total) are real WoW material names/icons beyond the core 1-60 leveling path - Outland-through-Pandaria-era ore/leather/cloth that were never wired into a recipe or gathering table for this project, included specifically so future profession/recipe expansion has genuine, verified, lore-consistent material names ready to use instead of inventing new ones on the spot. Every backup entry was checked against the real icon archive the same way as the core 87 - nothing here is placeholder or invented art.

_profession_notes.mining: Gathering. Produces ore (raw) and stone. Ore is smelted into bars (a crafting step, not a separate material - bars are just a later-tier 'material' produced FROM ore, same as WoW). Feeds Blacksmithing, Engineering, Jewelcrafting-equivalent uses.
_profession_notes.herbalism: Gathering. Produces raw herbs. Feeds Alchemy directly, and Cooking/First Aid in small amounts (not modeled yet, no Cooking profession exists).
_profession_notes.skinning: Gathering. Produces leather/hide tiers from skinning beast corpses, gated by the CREATURE's level (not the player's skinning skill) - same convention this project already uses for loot generation. Feeds Leatherworking, and Tailoring/Blacksmithing in small amounts for leather-trimmed recipes.
_profession_notes.tailoring: Crafting. Consumes Herbalism-adjacent? No - consumes cloth, which drops from HUMANOID/UNDEAD/DEMON creatures directly (not gathered via a profession skill the way ore/herbs/leather are - matches real WoW, cloth has no gathering profession of its own, anyone can loot it). Produces cloth gear + bags (see bags.json) + bolts (a crafting intermediate).
_profession_notes.leatherworking: Crafting. Consumes Skinning's leather/hide tiers. Produces leather/mail gear.
_profession_notes.blacksmithing: Crafting. Consumes Mining's bars (smelted ore) + occasional Skinning leather for hilts/trim. Produces plate/mail gear and weapons.
_profession_notes.alchemy: Crafting. Consumes Herbalism's raw herbs. Produces potions/elixirs/flasks (Consumable items, not Item gear - see entities/consumable.py).
_profession_notes.engineering: Crafting. Consumes Mining's bars + stone + a few Herbalism/cloth odds and ends. Produces gadgets/consumables/ranged weapon ammo (not modeled - no ammo system exists yet).
_profession_notes.enchanting: Crafting. Consumes DISENCHANTED gear (dust/essence/shard materials come from breaking down Items, not gathered directly) - Strange/Soul/Vision/Illusion/Dream Dust tiers correlate to the item level of what's disenchanted, not to a cloth or ore tier directly, though in practice they roughly track the cloth tiers since most disenchant fodder is armor. Modeled here as a separate material list since disenchanting itself isn't built yet either.

materials.name: Copper Ore
materials.flavor_text: Soft, reddish metal. Everyone starts here.

materials.name: Tin Ore
materials.flavor_text: Alloys with copper to make bronze.

materials.name: Silver Ore
materials.flavor_text: Shinier than tin, and worth more.

materials.name: Iron Ore
materials.flavor_text: Foundational material for real weapons and armor.

materials.name: Gold Ore
materials.flavor_text: Too soft for armor, but jewelers and nobles love it.

materials.name: Mithril Ore
materials.flavor_text: Half the weight of iron, twice the strength.

materials.name: Truesilver Ore
materials.flavor_text: Rare and prized - holy and arcane crafters both want it.

materials.name: Thorium Ore
materials.flavor_text: The endgame ore. Heavy, dense, and everywhere at the top of the world.

materials.name: Dark Iron Ore
materials.flavor_text: Forged in the deep places under the mountain. Not found casually.

materials.name: Rough Stone
materials.flavor_text: Common rubble. Blacksmiths and alchemists both use small amounts.

materials.name: Coarse Stone
materials.flavor_text: A step up from rough stone, still plentiful.

materials.name: Heavy Stone
materials.flavor_text: Dense and useful for reinforcing heavier gear.

materials.name: Solid Stone
materials.flavor_text: Solid all the way through - good for high-durability crafts.

materials.name: Dense Stone
materials.flavor_text: The heaviest, densest stone worth carrying.

materials.name: Copper Bar
materials.flavor_text: Smelted from copper ore.

materials.name: Bronze Bar
materials.flavor_text: Copper and tin, smelted together.

materials.name: Silver Bar
materials.flavor_text: Smelted silver ore.

materials.name: Iron Bar
materials.flavor_text: Smelted from iron ore. The backbone of real armor.

materials.name: Steel Bar
materials.flavor_text: Iron, refined further with coal.

materials.name: Gold Bar
materials.flavor_text: Smelted gold ore.

materials.name: Mithril Bar
materials.flavor_text: Smelted mithril. Prized by engineers and smiths alike.

materials.name: Truesilver Bar
materials.flavor_text: Smelted truesilver. Rare and valuable.

materials.name: Thorium Bar
materials.flavor_text: Smelted thorium. The endgame smith's staple.

materials.name: Peacebloom
materials.flavor_text: The most common herb in the world - every apprentice starts here.

materials.name: Silverleaf
materials.flavor_text: Grows in the shade of trees near every starting zone.

materials.name: Earthroot
materials.flavor_text: Found clinging to cliffs and rocky slopes.

materials.name: Mageroyal
materials.flavor_text: A favorite of apprentice alchemists everywhere.

materials.name: Briarthorn
materials.flavor_text: Thorny and stubborn - matches the zones it grows in.

materials.name: Stranglekelp
materials.flavor_text: Pulled from coastal shallows, not picked from soil.

materials.name: Bruiseweed
materials.flavor_text: Grows near buildings and ruins.

materials.name: Wild Steelbloom
materials.flavor_text: Metallic-edged petals - said to steel the drinker's nerve.

materials.name: Kingsblood
materials.flavor_text: Deep red, and named for a reason nobody quite remembers.

materials.name: Liferoot
materials.flavor_text: Found near water. A staple of restorative brews.

materials.name: Fadeleaf
materials.flavor_text: Its color seems to shift when you're not looking directly at it.

materials.name: Goldthorn
materials.flavor_text: Grows on cliffs, gold-tipped and sharp.

materials.name: Khadgar's Whisker
materials.flavor_text: Named for the archmage - found under trees in older forests.

materials.name: Sungrass
materials.flavor_text: Grows in open, sunlit meadows at higher elevation.

materials.name: Golden Sansam
materials.flavor_text: A root, not a leaf - dug up rather than picked.

materials.name: Dreamfoil
materials.flavor_text: Its scent alone is said to bring vivid dreams.

materials.name: Mountain Silversage
materials.flavor_text: High-altitude only. Silvery leaves, strong scent.

materials.name: Plaguebloom
materials.flavor_text: Grows only where the land itself has gone wrong.

materials.name: Icecap
materials.flavor_text: Frost-hardy, found only in the coldest reaches.

materials.name: Gromsblood
materials.flavor_text: Named for the orc who changed the fate of his people.

materials.name: Black Lotus
materials.flavor_text: Rare beyond rare. Master alchemists build their finest work around one bloom.

materials.name: Ruined Leather Scraps
materials.flavor_text: Barely worth calling leather. Good for nothing but selling.

materials.name: Light Leather
materials.flavor_text: Thin, supple, easy to work. Every leatherworker starts here.

materials.name: Medium Leather
materials.flavor_text: Sturdier than light leather, from tougher beasts.

materials.name: Heavy Leather
materials.flavor_text: Thick, tough hide from dangerous game.

materials.name: Thick Leather
materials.flavor_text: Almost armor on its own. Prized by leatherworkers.

materials.name: Rugged Leather
materials.flavor_text: The toughest hide most beasts in the world can offer.

materials.name: Linen Cloth
materials.flavor_text: Plain woven cloth, looted from nearly anyone.

materials.name: Wool Cloth
materials.flavor_text: Coarser and warmer than linen.

materials.name: Silk Cloth
materials.flavor_text: Fine and valuable - looted mostly from cultists and bandits.

materials.name: Mageweave Cloth
materials.flavor_text: Threaded with faint arcane residue.

materials.name: Runecloth
materials.flavor_text: Etched with runes by whoever wore it last - usually didn't end well for them.

materials.name: Felcloth
materials.flavor_text: Looted only from demons. Warm, and faintly wrong to the touch.

materials.name: Strange Dust
materials.flavor_text: The most basic enchanting dust. Every disenchanted rag yields a little.

materials.name: Lesser Magic Essence
materials.flavor_text: A faint spark of magic, condensed.

materials.name: Greater Magic Essence
materials.flavor_text: A stronger dose of the same spark.

materials.name: Soul Dust
materials.flavor_text: Finer than strange dust, from better-made gear.

materials.name: Lesser Astral Essence
materials.flavor_text: A minor astral fragment.

materials.name: Greater Astral Essence
materials.flavor_text: A concentrated astral fragment.

materials.name: Small Glimmering Shard
materials.flavor_text: A rare crystalline byproduct of disenchanting.

materials.name: Vision Dust
materials.flavor_text: Fine dust from mid-tier enchanted gear.

materials.name: Lesser Mystic Essence
materials.flavor_text: A minor mystic fragment.

materials.name: Greater Mystic Essence
materials.flavor_text: A concentrated mystic fragment.

materials.name: Small Glowing Shard
materials.flavor_text: Glows faintly even in daylight.

materials.name: Large Glowing Shard
materials.flavor_text: A larger, brighter version of the small shard.

materials.name: Illusion Dust
materials.flavor_text: Shimmers faintly - hard to look at directly.

materials.name: Lesser Nether Essence
materials.flavor_text: A minor fragment of nether energy.

materials.name: Greater Nether Essence
materials.flavor_text: A concentrated fragment of nether energy.

materials.name: Small Radiant Shard
materials.flavor_text: Radiates a soft light of its own.

materials.name: Large Radiant Shard
materials.flavor_text: A prized shard, sought after by enchanters.

materials.name: Dream Dust
materials.flavor_text: The finest dust available, from the finest gear.

materials.name: Lesser Eternal Essence
materials.flavor_text: A minor fragment of something that shouldn't fade.

materials.name: Greater Eternal Essence
materials.flavor_text: A concentrated fragment of something that shouldn't fade.

materials.name: Small Brilliant Shard
materials.flavor_text: Brilliant even against the sun.

materials.name: Large Brilliant Shard
materials.flavor_text: The rarest, most sought-after enchanting shard.

materials.name: Crystal Vial
materials.flavor_text: An empty vial. Every potion needs one to hold it.

materials.name: Leaded Vial
materials.flavor_text: A reinforced vial for volatile mixtures.

materials.name: Coarse Thread
materials.flavor_text: Simple thread for simple stitching.

materials.name: Fine Thread
materials.flavor_text: Finer thread for finer work.

materials.name: Silken Thread
materials.flavor_text: Woven from silk itself - strong and nearly invisible.

materials.name: Rough Blasting Powder
materials.flavor_text: Coarse powder, ground from rough stone.

materials.name: Coarse Blasting Powder
materials.flavor_text: A step up from rough powder - still not very refined.

materials.name: Heavy Blasting Powder
materials.flavor_text: Dense powder, ground from heavy stone.

materials.name: Dense Blasting Powder
materials.flavor_text: The finest, most volatile powder engineers can grind.

materials.name: Fel Iron Ore
materials.flavor_text: Warped by fel energy. Heavier than it looks.

materials.name: Adamantite Ore
materials.flavor_text: Nearly indestructible in its raw form.

materials.name: Cobalt Ore
materials.flavor_text: Faint blue veins run through this ore.

materials.name: Khorium Ore
materials.flavor_text: Rare, valuable, and always in short supply.

materials.name: Saronite Ore
materials.flavor_text: Cold to the touch, even fresh from the vein.

materials.name: Titanium Ore
materials.flavor_text: Impossibly light for how strong it is.

materials.name: Obsidium Ore
materials.flavor_text: Volcanic glass fused with raw metal.

materials.name: Elementium Ore
materials.flavor_text: Unstable and reactive - handle with care.

materials.name: Pyrite Ore
materials.flavor_text: Fool's gold to the untrained eye. It isn't.

materials.name: Ghost Iron Ore
materials.flavor_text: Faintly translucent. Some swear it whispers.

materials.name: Trillium Ore
materials.flavor_text: A rare vein that alternates black and white striations.

materials.name: Firebloom
materials.flavor_text: Warm to the touch and smells faintly of smoke.

materials.name: Arthas' Tears
materials.flavor_text: Pale and cold. Nobody quite likes picking it.

materials.name: Ghost Mushroom
materials.flavor_text: Grows only in total darkness, deep in caves.

materials.name: Golden Lotus
materials.flavor_text: One of the rarest blooms in the world.

materials.name: Purple Lotus
materials.flavor_text: Grows around old ruins, for reasons nobody's explained.

materials.name: Grave Moss
materials.flavor_text: Found only near graves and crypts. Best picked quickly.

materials.name: Frost Lotus
materials.flavor_text: Blooms even in the deepest winter.

materials.name: Gold Clover
materials.flavor_text: Said to bring luck, though alchemists just want it for potions.

materials.name: Heart Blossom
materials.flavor_text: Its petals pulse faintly, like a heartbeat.

materials.name: Star Moss
materials.flavor_text: Glimmers faintly under moonlight.

materials.name: Savage Leather
materials.flavor_text: Tanned from something that fought hard not to give it up.

materials.name: Pristine Leather
materials.flavor_text: Not a single flaw in the hide.

materials.name: Cragscale Hide
materials.flavor_text: Rough, rocky texture - from something that lived among cliffs.

materials.name: Dredged Leather
materials.flavor_text: Pulled from something that lived where the light doesn't reach.

materials.name: Stonehide Leather
materials.flavor_text: Nearly as tough as the stone it's named for.

materials.name: Stormscale
materials.flavor_text: Crackles faintly with static when handled.

materials.name: Fiendish Leather
materials.flavor_text: Something about it makes your skin crawl.

materials.name: Netherweave Cloth
materials.flavor_text: Woven with faint threads of something not quite of this world.

materials.name: Frostweave Cloth
materials.flavor_text: Cold and stiff until worked - then it's the warmest cloth there is.

materials.name: Windwool Cloth
materials.flavor_text: Impossibly light. Practically floats.

materials.name: Imperial Silk
materials.flavor_text: Woven for royalty. Everyone else has to earn it.

materials.name: Soulcloth
materials.flavor_text: Warm, dark, and faintly aware of being handled.

materials.name: Fel Iron Bar
materials.flavor_text: Smelted fel iron. Still faintly warped.

materials.name: Adamantite Bar
materials.flavor_text: Smelted adamantite. Nearly unbreakable.

materials.name: Cobalt Bar
materials.flavor_text: Smelted cobalt ore.

materials.name: Ghost Iron Bar
materials.flavor_text: Smelted ghost iron. Still faintly translucent.

materials.name: Trillium Bar
materials.flavor_text: Smelted trillium, striations intact.

materials.name: Khorium Bar
materials.flavor_text: Smelted khorium. As rare as the ore itself.

materials.name: Saronite Bar
materials.flavor_text: Smelted saronite. Still cold.

materials.name: Titanium Bar
materials.flavor_text: Smelted titanium. Barely heavier than the ore.

materials.name: Obsidium Bar
materials.flavor_text: Smelted obsidium.

materials.name: Elementium Bar
materials.flavor_text: Smelted elementium. Still faintly unstable.

materials.name: Pyrite Bar
materials.flavor_text: Smelted pyrite.
